tracks.name: harness-glm-5-3-flash
tracks.description: Dwarf Fortress 53.16 fortress mode through a fixed facts-only game API (dfbench/v3). Submit a harness (Dockerfile + entrypoint) that plays with one fixed model, z-ai/glm-5.3-flash via the organiser's metered gateway: $0.50 credits and 90 min wall per game-year. Score = one-sided 95% lower bound of S = 0.5 OP1 + 0.3 MY1 + 0.2 labs (LT01, LT02, LT03, LT08) on a private seasonal fort pool. Local runs use public seeds and are not ranked.
tracks.hardware: Local runs: x86_64 Linux with Docker (macOS Apple Silicon works under Rosetta, slower), your own Dwarf Fortress 53.16 + DFHack 53.16-r2 download, ~1 vCPU and 2-3 GB RAM per game plus 1 vCPU and 2 GB for the harness, ~20 GB disk, and your own model API key. Official scoring runs on the challenge's own x86_64 runners.
